verified: Tesla's own robotaxi social accounts posted that select customers were invited to purchase a Cybercab for $29,900 with December delivery, describing it as a limited release; the vehicle has no steering wheel or pedals.
unconfirmed: how many cars or buyers are included, what the $299 monthly charge pays for, whether regulators in buyers' states will permit private ownership of a vehicle without steering-wheel or brake controls, and whether December deliveries will actually happen.

verified: 特斯拉的 robotaxi 账号宣布已邀请“部分客户”购买双座 Cybercab，并称售价 29,900 美元、计划 12 月交付；报道称还需每月支付 299 美元。
unconfirmed: 受邀客户和车辆的具体数量、299 美元月费的实际覆盖内容、12 月能否如期交付，以及车辆在公开道路上的自动驾驶表现，均无独立验证；报道也明确指出受邀人数不明。

titles.en: Tesla offers select customers a $29,900 Cybercab with a $299 monthly fee
titles.zh: 特斯拉向受邀客户开卖Cybercab，月费299美元
